reviewer: Independent western-language reviewer /root/check_mac_resume/review_western_batch_two, separate from writers
review_scope: Read every Chinese source paragraph alongside both complete French and Spanish translations, in order: 192 source paragraphs and 384 target paragraphs, plus titles, decks, chapter labels and entry doors. Semantically checked ownership and personal boundaries, informed choice and privacy, explanation versus approval, disappointment versus commands, refusal versus coercion, all examples and responsibility qualifications. Corrected localized precision and typography after actual reading. Structural checks supplement, not replace, this semantic review.
limitations: AI linguistic review, not external human certification. Scope is French and Spanish articles06–10 only. No public rendering, visual review or publication performed. Article10 original deck is stronger than paragraph12; both claims remain faithfully translated, with author decision separate and Chinese sources untouched.

findings.issue: Preserve the shift in what belongs to each person toward shared ownership, rather than making the things themselves become a we.
findings.before: Derrière ces questions se trouve une attente très naturelle : puisque deux personnes sont suffisamment proches, ce qui appartenait au « toi » et au « moi » devrait progressivement devenir un « nous ».
findings.after: Derrière ces questions se trouve une attente très naturelle : puisque deux personnes sont suffisamment proches, ce qui appartenait au « toi » et au « moi » devrait progressivement devenir ce qui appartient au « nous ».
